fml.menu.mods.info.description.distracti: A client-side NeoForge mod that hides the EMI or JEI recipe list while its search field is empty. It can also hide the empty EMI Favorites sidebar, including its background and header buttons. Shows the current favorite keybind in an empty Favorites sidebar. Includes optional search hints, toggle controls, reduced search-field background opacity, and independent JEI toolbar button visibility.
